title: Mudhal Mariyadhai
desc: A middle-aged upper-caste man, Malaichami, leads an unhappy married life but seeks comfort in a new friendship with a low-caste woman. However, their friendship leads to many rumours in their village.

title: Karmegam
desc: A military officer returns home to find his village stuck in the past, under the thumb of an abusive landlord. He urges them to revolt against their oppressor and learns a dark secret about his past.

title: Vandhaan Vendraan
desc: On the request of the woman he loves, Arjun goes to great lengths to put his half-brother Ramana, who is a don, behind bars. However, his attempts put him in a dangerous situation.

title: Oru Melliya Kodu
desc: A deceased woman's husband becomes a suspect after her body goes missing from the morgue. The disappearance exposes a web of lies and deceit when things unravel.

title: Senthamizh Paattu
desc: Despite his mother's objection to singing songs, Bala develops an interest in music. He falls in love with Durga, a rich girl with whose family his mother's miseries are interlinked.
